Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, and wherein said alignment device is configured to output data that facilitates user interaction with a user interface presenting the documented procedure.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and outputs data indicative of the next step to enable the user interface to present the next step visually.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on a comparison of textual elements from the user interface and the documented procedure to enhance user understanding of the alignment. 

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to provide feedback to the user interface regarding the alignment.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on stored data regarding previous user interactions with respect to the documented procedure, thereby improving the accuracy of the alignment.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps and presenting them contextually to the user for improved guidance.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and enabling presentation of the next step to the user interface for visual confirmation.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on a comparison of textual elements from the user interface and the documented procedure to improve alignment effectiveness. 

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, enabling a more accurate alignment assessment.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on data representing previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, aiming to refine the alignment outcomes.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps using an automated process to facilitate user interaction with the procedure.
